summary.text: Volkswagen Group reported 2026-Q2 revenue of EUR 82.4bn and operating profit of EUR 3.5bn (margin 4.2%). Q2 2026 revenue (82,444m) and operating result (3,469m) match the Volkswagen Group release. The company reports earnings after tax of 1,538m for Q2 2026; the aggregator's 1,284m is a different basis (likely attributable to shareholders), so net profit is not the company headline figure.
